3. THE SUBCOLLECTOR, , NANDYALA DISTRICT, NANDYALA  ANDHRA PRADESH  4. THE TAHSILDAR, GADIVEMULA MANDAL, GADIVEMULA,
 NANDYALA DISTRICT, ANDHRA PRADESH  ...RESPONDENT(S):
 Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be pleased topleased to pass an order or direction or Writ,
more specificaily one in the nature of a writ of mandamus declaring proceedings bearing reference number Rc.B.238/2018 dated 09-03- 2021, passed by the Sub-Collector Nandyal , i.e.. Respondent Number 3 in rejecting the payment of compensation for lands of the petitioners resumed for public purpose on par with payment of Rs 5.50 Lakhs per acre as paid to patta holders and instead paying only Rs 4.20 lakhs per acre in respect of the land holding of the petitioners resumed by the respondents as illegal, contrary to the settled law laid down by the honourable High Court of Andhra Pradesh in Mekala Pandu case and and as confirmed by the Honble Supreme Court in Civil Appeal No 7904-7912 dated 04-08-2014 and consequently direct payment of the balance Rs.1.3 lakhs Per acre in respect of the land holding of the petitioners indicated in the table below .duly setting aside the orders  3 bearing reference number Rc.B.238/2018 dated 09-03-2021 insofar as the petitioners are concerned with ali applicable consequential benefits E.Sridevi vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126697036/
2 including interest from the date of taking possession on 03-03-2015 and pass IA NO: 1 OF 2023  Petition under Section 151 CPC praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased leased to direct that the above writ petition to be taken up out of turn and directed to be posted for final hearing as the petitioners' lands were taken away from them as far back as in the year 2015 and pass Counsel for the Petitioner(S):
 1. A SRINATH Counsel for the Respondent(S):
 1. GP FOR LAND ACQUISITION The Court made the following:
 4 THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE TARLADA RAJASEKHAR RAO  WRIT PETITION No.30760 of 2023 ORDER:
Learned counsel for petitioners appeared virtually and submitted that in view of amendment issued vide G.O.Ms.No.23, Revenue (Lands.I), dated 19.01.2024, the Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfers) (Amendment) Act, 2023, this writ petition has been rendered infructuous.
Recording the said submissions, the present Writ Petition is dismissed as infructuous.
